summary: The PR addresses the issue of adding a nullable OneToOneField crashing on SQLite by modifying the schema editor logic. However, it introduces unrelated files and could benefit from better readability.

issues.description: The PR includes a large number of unrelated files (test project setup) which should not be part of the core Django codebase.
The added condition in `schema.py` could be made more readable by using parentheses for clarity.
